rubric_source.scale: 0 not done; 1 partial; 2 done; 3 done plus above expectations
rubric_source.assessment_status: No jury scores assigned; this file maps current evidence, gaps, and tests only.

criteria.expectation: Map displays objects and does not crash or freeze during the demo.

verified_evidence.claim: The production preview renders all seven 3D Tiles descriptors in desktop and iPhone-13-sized Chromium emulation. The full browser suite passed 22/22 on citywide-v3 and separately 22/22 on live public citywide-v5 after versioned-root assertion maintenance; the application bundle was unchanged. The earlier seven-layer deep-zoom cache issue was corrected.

A separate post-v5 visual smoke passed 4/4 desktop/mobile-emulation views of a known and a newly selected five-part parent. The new parent's exact public-v5 detail GLB loaded with 7/7 layers, adjusted SSE 24, and no page, console, or HTTP errors. Physical iPhone hardware was not used.
Web/iOS Safari physical device and Unity native builds have not been run.

gap: No sustained pan/zoom/session stability test on a physical iPhone or Android device.
Large city tile completeness is not equivalent to smooth device rendering.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add repeatable multi-minute navigation and filter-refresh tests on real target devices, with no crashes, broken selections, or stale map state; report frame-time and memory budgets.
evidence_test: Run web E2E on desktop/mobile viewport and assert Cesium tiles, filtering, zero-result recovery, and no page errors.
On physical iPhone and Android, repeat pan/zoom/select/filter cycles and record crash-free result, frame-time, memory, and network errors.

criteria.expectation: Code is split into logical data, backend, and frontend modules.

verified_evidence.claim: Repository separates contracts, backend, recommendations, web, Unity mobile, source adapters, pipeline, quality, and integration checks.
Shared API and tiles are checked across layers by acceptance and live-contract scripts.
A linked architecture map documents module ownership, demo/real data separation, public projection, shared tiles, and validation boundaries.

gap: Generated-client contract drift is not yet checked automatically across backend, web, and Unity source.
Unity/Cesium project has not been compiled in its target Editor.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Automate versioned API/DTO compatibility checks across backend, web, and Unity, then validate the pinned Unity project in its target Editor.
evidence_test: Run the contract checker and acceptance suite from a clean environment; verify each service/client references the same OpenAPI/schema version.
Open/import the Unity project with the pinned Editor and record package/scene validation.

criteria.expectation: Filters change map results and use real sourced data, not fabricated values.

verified_evidence.claim: Budget, district, room, area, status, and typed predicates are applied before ranking; map/search share the same eligibility policy.
The runnable catalog is 100 fictional complexes and 1,000 illustrative offers; the real offer catalog is empty because no permitted live price feed exists.

gap: Filters work against demo offers, not real current apartment prices/availability.
This is the primary product-data blocker; real mode correctly returns zero offers rather than reusing demo stock.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Secure a documented permitted developer price feed, import dated current rows with source IDs, then demonstrate that each real filter changes matching offers and map markers while preserving unknowns.
evidence_test: With a cleared real-feed fixture, test every filter against independently checked source rows and assert map/search/recommendation parity.
Without a cleared live source, verify real mode stays empty and never displays demo offers.

criteria.expectation: Zero matches, missing fields, and other errors are handled in the UI without developer-looking failures.

verified_evidence.claim: The acceptance suite executes 100 cases; the full Chromium suite passes 22/22 on live v5 including empty/clarification states, typed-filter parity, Data-tab failure/retry, and API 500 recovery.
Missing/stale/unknown fields remain unknown and unavailable offers are excluded.

gap: Physical-device network failure and malformed GLB recovery are not yet evidenced; the browser fault checks cover only selected API failures.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add fault-injection cases for API timeout, malformed/partial tile response, corrupt source values, and retry recovery; keep all user-facing errors actionable and non-technical.
evidence_test: Run E2E with API 500/timeout and failed GLB requests; assert a visible recovery state, no page exception, and successful retry.
Run acceptance suite and report the exact case count without counting overlapping tests twice.

criteria.expectation: Map does not become slow at the intended displayed object volume.

verified_evidence.claim: City, road, park, and water layers use streamed coarse/detail 3D Tiles. A fixed 128 MiB web cache was reweighted toward city detail after a seven-layer deep-zoom failure; the corrected mobile browser check selected 12 city detail tiles.
Independent source-index audit found all 564,031 IDs represented and largest detail GLB 2,699,044 bytes / 21,444 triangles; this is not a device benchmark.

A fixed citywide-v3 Linux headless software-GL close-zoom trace transferred 35.28 MB desktop / 32.76 MB mobile emulation; rendered-frame interval P95 was 139.6 / 153.1 ms. This is a measurable browser load cost, not iPhone FPS or a v5 performance benchmark.

A separate live-v5 Linux headless Chromium trace at the new five-part target (157 m camera height, eight zoom steps) transferred 19.32/19.91 MiB desktop/mobile emulation with rendered-frame-interval P95 85.6/64.0 ms. The v3 and v5 traces use different camera paths and are not a speedup comparison or physical-iPhone FPS.

gap: No frame-time/RSS benchmark on a physical phone across citywide traversal.
The close-zoom headless transfer and frame intervals are costly; browser emulation does not establish acceptable device/network performance.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Publish a reproducible device matrix with cold/warm load, p50/p95 frame time, peak memory, transfer bytes, and tile failure rates for selected dense and sparse areas.
evidence_test: Automate a fixed camera-route benchmark over coarse and detail cells and validate resource ceilings.
Repeat route on physical iPhone and Android under a documented network profile.

criteria.expectation: Another computer can install and run the project from instructions with requirements, dependencies, settings, and a reproducible deployment path.

verified_evidence.claim: README documents runtime prerequisites and commands for demo generation, web/API start, and checks; npm lockfile is present.

A project-owned clean Python environment ran 67 backend/collection/recommendation/integration tests and 69 source-adapter tests without skips; the managed LAN production preview and API-only restart were checked. The documented citywide-v3 to citywide-v5 to sanitized-public build order preserves published source and audit artifacts.

gap: No Docker Compose/container deployment package is evidenced.
Large city GeoParquet/GLBs and Unity Editor/platform modules are external prerequisites, not shipped artifacts.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Provide a clean-machine bootstrap or Docker Compose profile for API/web, a data-artifact manifest and preflight check, and an optional Unity build checklist with pinned Editor/modules.
evidence_test: Build and launch from a fresh checkout with only documented prerequisites; validate health, map tiles, and search.
Test declared failure messages when large data or Unity platform modules are absent.

criteria.expectation: At least two real open data sources are used; no fabricated or hard-coded source records.

verified_evidence.claim: Real Overture building footprints and OSM POIs/boundary are retained with snapshots, hashes, IDs, and bounded coverage notes.
New district candidate layer is pinned to Overture Divisions release 2026-09-23.1; playground environmental pilot reuses real OSM records.

A pinned Geofabrik/OSM city clip yielded roads, parks, water, and 50,330 social POI-category records; separate official Minstroy permits and Moscow OSM construction candidates are registry/status data, not offers.

The OSM/Overture part source has 29,714 parts linked to 6,263 city parents; only 166 parents and 800 exact-version, geometry-gated parts are in the current stepped render. A separate offline pedestrian graph passed seven POI-access-point route smokes but cannot populate complex-origin walking-time facts yet.

gap: Current apartment offer prices and live availability are absent; demo catalog remains illustrative despite several real geospatial/registry sources.
OSM feature completeness is unknown, and records from overlapping OSM-derived sources cannot be counted as independent observations of the same product fact.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Connect multiple rights-cleared feeds across distinct product facts, publish per-field coverage and freshness, and reconcile stable project/building IDs without treating map context as inventory.
evidence_test: For each displayed fact, trace source record ID, snapshot, date, license, and normalizer in an exportable source audit.
Run source-specific coverage checks and ensure no sample/demo record is counted as real inventory.

criteria.expectation: Team can explain source, license, terms, and compliant collection.

verified_evidence.claim: OSM and Overture attribution/license obligations are recorded; source fields, hashes, query scope, and snapshot timestamps are preserved.
Production offer importer requires explicit cleared storage/display rights and rejects uncleared/test-only production rows.

Official Yandex/2GIS 3D renderer terms and Moscow model-submission access were reviewed; display access was not treated as a license to retain or repackage vendor building geometry. TUM GBA.LoD1 has a public Moscow tile but CC BY-NC 4.0 data terms and no inspected Moscow rows, so it is research-only for this commercial product. Open raster products are kept contextual, not claimed as individual building heights.

The current and previous compatible public tile releases redact source IDs in 15,280 GLBs while retaining mandatory map attribution. Active-root allowlisting denies raw internal tiles and manifests over HTTP; the independent auditor confirmed unchanged binary geometry.

gap: No licensed current price source has been secured; public reference-data access is not treated as redistribution permission.
Final production legal review of ODbL-derived distributions and vendor display rights remains open.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Maintain a per-source rights dossier with permitted collection, storage, transformation, redistribution, attribution text, and approval evidence; block each dataset whose rights are not cleared.
evidence_test: Run importer tests for cleared, uncleared, expired, and test-only rights contexts.
Audit each shipped data manifest and displayed attribution against its license and source terms.

criteria.expectation: Records from different sources share normalized fields for price, dates, area, and related criteria.

verified_evidence.claim: Versioned OpenAPI/JSON schemas and a generated criteria registry define stable types, scopes, operators, and unknown policies.
Source adapters preserve lossless source fields and field-level provenance; offers and units have separate IDs.

gap: No permitted live price feed has exercised full multi-source normalization in production mode.
Some environmental source schemas remain inaccessible or unknown.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add a versioned cross-source mapping registry and replayable migration/contract tests for price basis, time precision, units, IDs, and provenance across two real permitted feeds.
evidence_test: Validate adapter output against the shared schema and compare equivalent source rows for consistent normalized values.
Run backward-compatibility checks for existing API/mobile/web consumers.

criteria.expectation: Duplicates, missing values, and clear outliers are handled explicitly.

verified_evidence.claim: City footprint processing validates geometry/IDs and clips against a pinned OSM mask; missing heights/floors are counted and kept distinct from render fallbacks.
Offer adapters reject duplicate source IDs, invalid units/ranges, stale/uncleared records, and non-positive price inputs; null facts remain explicit.
A conservative render-height overlay changed only 59 of 440,304 previously fallback buildings; a disjoint holdout matched 52/862 and reports error only on those matches.

The current stepped renderer admitted 166 of 6,263 source-linked parent groups and 800 of 29,714 parts after exact OSM ID/version, positive height, parent coverage and bounded 3D-overlap checks. For those exact-version OSM rows height is ground-to-top, min_height is the lower Z, and roof:height is already inside total height; parent height/floor facts are unchanged. Excluded groups remain source data and are not all called invalid.

gap: No live price rows exist for market outlier review or source-to-source duplicate reconciliation.
Source height coverage remains sparse; the estimated render-height overlay is not measured building data and city completeness is not proven.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Produce a per-ingest quarantine report for duplicates, invalid units, missingness, stale rows, and robustly flagged price outliers with source context and human review before publication.
evidence_test: Run duplicate/missing/outlier fixtures and verify rejected rows are counted with reasons while valid records remain reproducible.
Re-run city source-ID/geometry audit after any source update.

criteria.expectation: Metrics respond to the target user's actual needs, rather than being included merely because a source contains them.

verified_evidence.claim: Business brief identifies the buyer's hard constraints and maps budget, area, rooms, district, and offer freshness to the search flow.
Environmental matrix separates measured noise from road/airport proximity and refuses to invent district air ranks.

gap: Persona and priority assumptions have not been validated with target buyers.
Some desired criteria are unknown because no source currently reports them.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Run task-based research with target buyers, map each high-priority question to a source-backed field and unknown policy, and remove or defer metrics that do not affect decisions.
evidence_test: Give users fixed purchase scenarios and record which fields change shortlist decisions; compare against the chosen filter set.
Audit every recommendation input to confirm source, scope, freshness, and coverage are visible.

criteria.expectation: Explain what numbers mean, including context for differences such as district price premiums.

verified_evidence.claim: City-data and business reports explain footprint/height coverage, render fallbacks, source limits, and why proximity/unknown counts are not quality scores.
No current real offer prices are available to calculate district price premiums or market comparisons.
The user chose source-backed numerical district facts as the product direction; current environmental matrix keeps unsupported district air ratings unknown.

gap: No verified price context can explain district-level market differences; demo prices must not support such claims.
Environmental district facts and current air rating remain unavailable/unknown.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Once real prices and complete boundary/source coverage exist, publish date-qualified district comparisons with sample sizes, definitions, confounders, and uncertainty; suppress unsupported conclusions.
evidence_test: Recompute a district comparison from an independently audited real snapshot and verify denominators, price basis, period, and boundary version.
Check narrative claims against source queries and suppress results below agreed coverage/sample thresholds.

criteria.expectation: Implement a dashboard with requested metrics/reports and plausible data.

verified_evidence.claim: Backend provides privacy-limited event metrics; documentation defines counts and timing with a minimum sample threshold.

The approved in-product Data tab uses /v1/data-coverage and separates demo offers, current real offers, and city geometry; 55 offer-field coverage rows, quality partitions, and bounded offer-only price/area distributions are checked against source counts.

gap: No real-user cohort exists; current /v1/metrics includes QA/demo traffic and is not a user funnel or business conversion report.
No current licensed price feed exists for market distributions or district-price conclusions; demo charts remain explicitly illustrative.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add a privacy-safe internal usage dashboard only after real-user/QA separation and sufficient samples; pair it with a rights-cleared offer feed for real-market charts while keeping dataset/quality labels.
evidence_test: Compare each Data tab count, 55-field partition, and offer-only chart denominator with /v1/data-coverage and its frozen schema; verify real0 stays empty.
Verify QA exclusion, privacy rules, minimum timing sample thresholds, and no sale/conversion claim from automated UI events.

criteria.expectation: Rule or AI recommender ranking is understandable and meaningful; ML accuracy itself is not the criterion.

verified_evidence.claim: Rules apply hard filters before ranking and expose explanation reasons; unknown or insufficient social coverage does not create a positive score.
Acceptance and tests include conditional-price, unknown-coverage, district, and unavailable-offer cases.

gap: Ranking has not been checked against target-buyer preferences or choices.
Real offer inventory is absent, so output examples are illustrative.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add a transparent reason breakdown, run blind buyer comparisons against unranked shortlists, and document whether recommendations improve relevant choice without violating hard constraints.
evidence_test: Property-test that all hard-filter failures are excluded and unknown criteria never increase score.
Run a small pre-registered buyer ranking task and report agreement, disagreements, and reasons without claiming ML accuracy.

criteria.expectation: A person outside the team understands what to do within one minute.

verified_evidence.claim: First screen labels the demo, presents search/filter controls, map/list views, counts, and empty/loading/error states.

gap: No timed unmoderated usability test with people outside the team is recorded.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Run a first-use task with representative buyers, measure task completion and time-to-first-relevant result, and iterate based on observed confusion rather than internal preference.
evidence_test: Ask a participant with no briefing to find a new-build apartment under a stated budget and explain the result source; record completion under 60 seconds and errors.

criteria.expectation: Filters are grouped by meaning and important filters remain visible.

verified_evidence.claim: Primary budget/room/area/district controls are separate from expandable advanced filters; advanced filters group property, social, and environment fields.
Available controls respect the registry's `filterable` and supported operators.

gap: Priority and grouping have not been validated by a target-user test; unavailable criteria may change as sources arrive.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Validate labels/order with target buyers and show each filter's availability/coverage without hiding the most common constraints.
evidence_test: Observe users choosing a budget, rooms, district, and one optional criterion; record misclicks, time, and whether they understand strict/unknown behavior.

criteria.expectation: A project card/map detail is not overloaded and information is prioritized.

verified_evidence.claim: Cards expose project/district, price, area/rooms, source quality, and date. The default public API projection hides provider identity; integration checks inspect search, map, detail, recommendation, comparison, and registry responses.
Procedural facades and demo prices are labeled as illustrative; real facade models are not claimed.

gap: Card hierarchy has no external comprehension/readability study and uses demo content in the current runnable catalog.
Physical-device readability and understanding of conditional versus asking price have not been validated with target buyers.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Validate a compact card with target buyers and progressive disclosure for source, price basis, and unknown facts; use real licensed project data before claiming the listing experience is complete.
evidence_test: Ask participants to identify total price, price conditions, area, source date, and unknown availability from a card within a short timed task.
Inspect all public routes and cards for provider names/identifiers; verify status, date, units, price basis, and mandatory map attribution remain visible.

criteria.expectation: Users can see that a filter applied through a result count and map/list update.

verified_evidence.claim: List count distinguishes displayed rows from full matches; map markers and search use the same eligibility snapshot, verified by live contract check.
Loading, empty, error, clarification, and retry states are explicit.

gap: No real-user perception test or low-bandwidth response-time evidence is recorded.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Add immediate applied-filter feedback with accessible status announcements and measured response budgets under slow network conditions.
evidence_test: Apply a filter and assert count, cards, and markers change to the same result set; test delay/retry and assistive status announcements.

criteria.expectation: One visual style, readable fonts/colors, and a map that does not look assembled from unrelated designs.

verified_evidence.claim: The light UI, darker citywide-v3 massing, visible roads, pastel-green parks, and pastel-blue water appear together in final desktop/mobile Chromium screenshots; seven-layer detail selection and no horizontal overflow were checked.

The separate v5 desktop/mobile screenshots show a new five-part stepped group with no full parent shell covering the wings; all seven layers remain visible and the browser smoke reported no overflow or errors.
User-approved visual direction: light baseline, darker buildings, visible roads, pastel-green parks, and pastel-blue water. Comparison UI work is deferred; no branded concept title is inferred.

gap: No physical-device visual/contrast review or external design/readability study is recorded.
The Unity source has matching layer descriptors and a weighted cache policy but has not been rendered in Unity Editor or on a native device.
criteria.concrete_extra_for_3: Verify contrast and readability of the approved map/UI palette on physical iPhone and Android devices, import the Unity scene in the pinned Editor, and record an external design review; keep comparison controls deferred and public provider identities hidden.
evidence_test: Run contrast and responsive checks on the approved screens and verify roads/building/park/water contrast at supported map zoom levels.
Have external reviewers identify the visual hierarchy and source status without prompting; inspect public screens for provider identity leakage.

product_decisions_not_made: Do not infer a branded concept title from the selected numerical district-facts direction.
Comparison UI work is deferred by user decision.
Do not infer jury scores from this evidence map.
